_comment: Riddle Scramble: a pun riddle whose answer is spelled by one boxed letter from each scrambled word. The browser does the hard part — it matches answer letters to words and marks the positions (frontend riddle-scramble/build.ts) — so this prompt only has to supply riddles the page can use and a pool of theme words wide enough for that matching to succeed. Both come back in one call because a riddle with no words to spell it is not half a page, it is no page.
